prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Create a FINISHED display advertisement supplied by an independent advertiser, not a photograph for a web page, not a website component or card. The finished raster includes its own complete brand identity, campaign typography, artwork, persuasive copy and a prominent call-to-action drawn into the advertisement. All requested Italian wording must be exact and highly legible. Professional real-world ad agency art direction. Use only the brief's copy; no fake prices, discounts, deadlines or added claims. No weather-site branding or shared weather palette. No outer frame or watermark. Make the entire canvas the single ad; no grid of options, no mockup screen.
Format: wide billboard 970×250, ratio 3.88:1. Generate a wide horizontal canvas with this exact composition ratio.
Input image 1: booklet campaign visual identity reference. Recompose into this WIDE billboard rather than preserving the portrait.
Creative concept: a confident typographic product campaign. White background; huge dark indigo type fills the left half, lime brand accent. At right a realistic standing booklet with indigo cover, white title and lime/magenta/cyan/yellow metro routes with square white stops, recognizable as in the reference. A few metro lines travel across the white negative space to connect copy with the physical book. Keep the book large and fully visible.
Text verbatim: small brand "CVeDI"; main headline "La teoria, a portata di pagina."; supporting line "Comunicazione visiva e design delle interfacce"; prominent lime CTA containing "Sfoglia il booklet". White/indigo/lime, bold Inter-like sans, tight clean hierarchy, an unmistakable real editorial product ad.
